reviews.summary: The generalized bytes preserve the strict-false Blocks checkout contract. The three provider-facing readers are byte-identical to the retained successful run, while the changed pilot and scenario retain the same locks, checkout driver, strict-false assertions, provider correlation and receipt oracle.

The generalized bytes preserve the exact strict-false Blocks checkout oracle and lock scope. The retained provider proof remains applicable because checkout, provider-evidence and record-evidence are byte-identical while the changed composition preserves the false branch.

Focused test review approved the frozen strict-false definition, exact false eligibility and empty-token checks, unchanged provider readers, provider-write lock wrapper and complete order/provider correlation after generalization.
The current bundle preserves the retained run's one-shot execution, fail-closed evidence correlation, observer cleanup, durable journaling, quarantine behavior and zero-residue teardown guarantees.
The generalization preserves the false run's single-writer locks, durable submission journal, scoped observer lifecycle and deterministic teardown; provider-interacting helpers remain byte-identical.

The generalized false route preserves the visible order-received status, one semantic summary list and payment list item, Card or Visa semantics and exact last-four receipt oracle proved by the retained run.

Provider writes remain capability-gated and lock-owned, request and evidence validation fail closed, tracked proof stays redacted, and the retained successful run remains applicable to the current false branch.

The retained successful run remains applicable to the frozen strict-false Blocks route and unchanged readers, preserving one correlated request, response, order, payment method, intent, charge and capture graph, exact cardinality, required negatives, cleanup and redaction.
The false pilot remains a thin composition root over a cohesive shared scenario. Lock ownership, Blocks observation, strict-false validation and provider/order evidence boundaries remain intact.

The generalized helpers remain test-internal with all consumers updated and no production route, hook, response or public signature change; the false path preserves its original endpoints and payload contract.

Upstream route, payload, account, provider collection and receipt contracts align with the current false branch; only composition and shared branching changed, so the retained provider proof remains applicable.
All five bundle paths, imports, exports, REST routes, canonical title and annotation, frozen source contract, unique ledger mapping and retained provider-proof references resolve correctly.
